description: This PHP file is a server-side script for rendering a popup interface to select documents within the SuiteCRM application. It interacts with the Documents module, constructs HTML forms and lists, and leverages SuiteCRM's internal classes such as ListView and XTemplate to generate a user interface for document selection during email composition.

classes.name: XTemplate
classes.description: Template engine class used for rendering HTML templates, instantiated with the file 'modules/Emails/PopupDocuments.html'.

classes.name: ListView
classes.description: Class responsible for listing database records in the UI; configured here for displaying document records in popup format.

methods.name: _get_where_clause
methods.description: Method of DocumentPopupPicker class that returns the SQL WHERE clause for filtering documents.

methods.name: show_export_button
methods.description: Property of ListView controlling export button visibility.

methods.name: process_for_popups
methods.description: Property of ListView indicating processing mode suitable for popup display.

methods.name: setXTemplate
methods.description: Method to assign the XTemplate instance for rendering.

methods.name: setHeaderTitle
methods.description: Method to set the header title in the ListView.

methods.name: setHeaderText
methods.description: Method to set custom header text in the ListView.

methods.name: setQuery
methods.description: Method to define the database query parameters for the list view.

methods.name: setModStrings
methods.description: Method to assign translation strings for the current module.

methods.name: processListView
methods.description: Method to generate and output the HTML list of records based on the query.
